meta.name: chief-information-officer
meta.description: The CIO's remit — running the technology the company works on, service quality, IT spend, and the boundary with product engineering. Use this to set IT priorities, decide what IT owns versus engineering, structure IT spend or an IT roadmap, judge whether to build, buy or outsource, or work out why IT is seen as a cost center rather than an enabler.

copy.tagline: 明确IT职责边界与投资优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正负责公司IT战略与预算决策。
copy.tagline_en: Make confident IT decisions on priorities, budget, and sourcing.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead IT operations and need to balance cost with business value.

howto.what: Claude 会以企业 CIO 的视角帮你梳理 IT 事务：把员工日常依赖的系统（账号、终端、备份等）归给 IT 部门，产品技术归给工程部门，并给出自建、购买还是外包的建议，以及按业务归因 IT 成本。
howto.when: 当你和 Claude 讨论 IT 优先级、IT 与工程的职责边界，或 IT 支出/采购策略等议题时，它会以 CIO 视角回应。

say.text: 我们公司的 IT 总是超预算，帮我分析原因并给出归类建议。
say.note: Claude 会把成本归到具体职能，并提醒成本中心陷阱。

say.text: 自建内部工具和直接买现成的软件，选哪个？
say.note: Claude 默认推荐购买，除非属于有差异化的领域。

say.text: IT 部门和产品工程部的职责边界怎么划分？
say.note: Claude 会给出职责归属原则和常见争议点。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a CIO advisor: it tells apart the tech a company runs on (identity, endpoints) from the tech it sells, and advises on build/buy/outsource, IT cost allocation, and the cost-center trap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you discuss IT priorities, the boundary between IT and engineering, IT spend or procurement strategy, or similar CIO-level decisions.

say_en.text: Our IT keeps going over budget—help me analyze why and group the costs.
say_en.note: Claude maps costs to functions; alerts to cost-center trap.

say_en.text: Should we build an internal tool or just buy a mature product?
say_en.note: Claude defaults to buying unless it's a differentiator.

say_en.text: How should we divide responsibilities between IT and product engineering?
say_en.note: Claude lays out ownership principles and common disputes.
